item.title: FitTrack Ad From Supplied Screenshots

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen 16:9 ad for FitTrack using both screenshots. Show the home screen first, then the workout screen, and finish with the app name. Clean, energetic, with an upbeat instrumental beat and no voiceover. Other copy is your call.

item.tests: Uses supplied app screenshots faithfully in a finished landscape ad rather than inventing replacement screens.

answer_sheet.Brand and source images: FitTrack; use app-home.png followed by app-workout.png.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Clean and energetic; other design choices are your call.
answer_sheet.On-screen wording: End with FitTrack; other copy is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 10 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
The supplied FitTrack home screenshot appears before the supplied workout screenshot.
Both screenshots remain recognizable and readable, without invented replacement UI.
An upbeat instrumental track is audible, with no voiceover.

style.prompt: Create a polished 10-second FitTrack fitness app advertisement using BOTH supplied screenshot references. Landscape composition for a YouTube-style ad. Product-focused motion graphics, clean white background with blue and green accents matching the app. Show @home as a flat, front-facing app screen on the left, then introduce @workout as a matching flat app screen on the right. Gentle scale-up and smooth lateral camera motion, dynamic blue and green geometric accents around the screens, finishing with both screens side by side held clearly in view. Preserve the screenshots' layouts, colors, branding and existing UI words as faithfully as possible; do not invent new interface features. Keep the two screens visually separate and readable, never morph one interface into the other. No added slogans, captions, titles or extra on-screen copy. Soundtrack: upbeat energetic instrumental electronic fitness music with a punchy beat. No voiceover, no dialogue, no singing.
